question: How is the sacrificial animal defined within the circle of yoginīs?
premises: The animal is situated in the middle of the group of yoginīs.
It is called a paśu in the Kula tradition.
This designation is a doctrinal definition.
inference: In the Kula, the animal placed in the midst of the yoginīs is called the paśu.
plain_english: In the Kula, that animal situated in the middle of the group of yoginīs is called the paśu.
